episodes.174794: The moisture field of a tropical disturbance advancing into the Central Atlantic moved over the area. The available moisture enhanced the shower and thunderstorm activity over the area. This and a combination of previously saturated soils resulted in several flooding and mudslides reports.

events.narrative: Emergency Managers reported that Rio Coqui was out of its banks, flooding near 20 houses in Calle Betances in Salinas.
A person in social media reported that the area near Escuela Josefina Boya was flooded.
Emergency Managers indicated an electrical post down to strong gusty winds.
Emergency managers reported that PR-123 was impassable due to flooding, since Rio Canas was out of its banks.
Emergency managers reported that the river close to Mercedita Airport was out of its banks and was flooding the runway close to American Airlines.

Emergency managers indicated that they received several calls from the public indicating a funnel cloud near barrio San Antonio. This system might had touch ground very briefly, based on reports received.
